entries.title: CrossCode
entries.definitive_edition: CrossCode on Windows PC with A New Home DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with A New Home DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the cleanest complete route with the A New Home post-game DLC, strong update support, and the best capture/input flexibility. Console and cloud routes do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy CrossCode on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and add the A New Home DLC for the complete post-game story route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: A New Home is available on the main PC and console routes, and no platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented; PC is the cleanest complete capture path.

entries.remaster_caveats: A New Home is post-game DLC, not a sequel. Xbox Series X/S and PS5 are upgraded platform routes, not remasters.
